GEBCO · General Bathymetric Chart of the Oceans

The Ocean Floor

90°N–90°S · 180°W–180°E · WGS 84

Shaded-relief rendering of the latest GEBCO global terrain grid — a continuous depth model of the world ocean at 15 arc-second resolution.

Depth below sea level
−10,000 m−8,000−6,000−4,000−2,0000 m

Darker blues mark the abyssal plains and trenches; pale tones shallow toward the continental shelves. Land is shaded by elevation.

GEBCO's grid stitches together ship-borne soundings, satellite-derived gravity models, and crowdsourced depth data into a single global model of the seafloor. Only about a quarter of the ocean floor has been directly mapped by sonar — the rest is inferred, which is why the Seabed 2030 project exists.

Three sheets below zoom into some of the most dramatic terrain the grid captures.
